name: board-topbar-chip-visual
description: Board of directors top-bar chip (#1946): a board attached to a running game shows 'Q1 · <days>d · 60%' in the top bar; the chip is absent in a game without a board.

steps.description: Open a bare game; it has no board, so the chip is not on screen.
Attach a board (console-only primitive, no UI equivalent): quarter 1, confidence 60.
One day passes; the chip appears in the top bar and reads Q1, 29 days left, 60% confidence.
The console status agrees with the chip.
